name: quioteframework/dev-overlay
description: In-browser developer overlay for Quiote: a floating badge injected into HTML pages that collects exception details from the page itself and from every same-origin fetch()/XHR request. Only ever active when core.developer_exceptions is enabled.

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/dev-overlay/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
